title: KnowledgeChunk
description: Design proposal, not yet implemented (Phase 10). A chunk is the unit that a future RAG/semantic-search phase would embed and retrieve -- stored SEPARATELY from normalized knowledge, enrichment, and relations, never merged into any of them. See knowledge_chunking.md for full rationale.

ContentRole.description: 'correction' is only ever its own separate chunk (never merged with the statement it answers) -- see knowledge_chunking.md §5.

FigureRefSource.description: 'links.figures' is the reconstruction's own <figure id="..."> reference (usually not yet resolved to a real final-figure image). 'relation:illustrates' is a resolved edge from knowledge_relations.json, pointing at a real data/output/final_figures/ image -- see knowledge_chunking.md §6.

reconstructed_figure_id.description: From links.figures, if that is the source.

figure_id.description: A real data/output/final_figures/ figure_id, only when source is 'relation:illustrates' (or a future resolution step fills it in for a links.figures entry).

chunk_id.description: Deterministic: 'chunk-<chapter_id>-<source_item_ids joined by '+'>[-part<N>|-correction]' -- content-derived, never a counter.

order.description: The minimum normalized `order` among source_item_ids -- preserves global reading position for a chunk covering one or several items.

part_index.description: 0-based position when an oversized item was split into multiple chunks (§4); null otherwise.

part_count.description: Total number of statement parts the source item was split into; null when not split.

source_item_ids.description: One entry for a normal item-to-chunk mapping; 2+ ONLY for a confirmed fragmentation-repair merge (§3); never for two independently-authored items sharing nothing but a topic.

pdf_pages.description: Union of every source item's own provenance.pdf_pages, in ascending order.

topics.description: Union of the source item(s)' enrichment `topics`.

concepts.description: Union of the source item(s)' enrichment `concepts`.

text.description: The deterministically-assembled text a future embedding step would consume. Built ONLY from already-existing normalized fields (content/proof/exercise_details, or the correction content for a 'correction' chunk) -- never rewritten, summarized, or paraphrased.

related_chunk_ids.description: Other chunk_ids this one is linked to: its own correction/statement counterpart, and any knowledge_relations.json edge (applies_concept/illustrates) touching one of this chunk's source_item_ids, resolved to the chunk that now contains the target item -- metadata only, never changes chunk boundaries (§7).

has_uncertain_content.description: True if ANY source item's normalized `uncertainty.has_uncertain_markers`/`has_gap_markers` is true -- propagated, never re-derived.

boundaries.description: How source_item_ids/part_index were decided (whole-item default, split, or merge).

review_status.description: Same convention as every prior phase. 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' when this chunk's boundaries came from a merge or a split (a rule_based judgment call, not a plain 1:1 mapping) or when any figure_ref carries confidence 'low'/'medium'.
